title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the threshold kinetic energy T must be derived and presented accurately.

title: Final Value Evaluation
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical value of T must be calculated correctly as 286.2 MeV.

title: Probability Expression
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the normalized probability of producing a pi+ per unit solid angle must be correctly derived.

title: Kinematics Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the center-of-mass and laboratory frames must be clearly articulated in the context of the problem.

title: Singularity Explanation
description: Important Criteria: A brief explanation of how the singularity in the probability relates to the kinematics of the reaction must be provided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units in the calculations should be consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the derivation of T or the probability expression must be penalized.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing or incorrect factors in the final expressions for T or the probability must be noted.
